preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the lock() function with a time parameter (e.g., 1 second) to temporarily set ownership to address(0). This will disable all onlyOwner functions including fee adjustments, max transaction limits, and swap/liquidity features. Alternatively, call renounceOwnership() to permanently give up ownership. This disrupts contract management and can lead to frozen functionality.
